_comment: Append-only deploy history.  safe-deploy-digitalocean.sh appends after a successful post-deploy smoke; rollback-digitalocean.sh appends on rollback.  last_good_sha is the SHA we'd roll back TO if the current deploy fails its smoke test.  When no real deploy has ever succeeded, pre_first_deploy.acknowledged distinguishes 'never deployed yet' from 'file is missing/corrupt'.

pre_first_deploy.reason: Genoa has not yet had a production deploy via safe-deploy-digitalocean.sh.  This is a deliberate pre-launch governance state, not a missing file or a stale record.  Auditors must NOT treat this as evidence of a smoke-pass; deploys remain BLOCKED until the first safe-deploy run populates last_good_sha + last_good_deploy_id + a non-empty deploys[] entry.
pre_first_deploy.rescind_when: First successful run of safe-deploy-digitalocean.sh writes deploys[0] and sets last_good_sha — this block should then be removed in the same commit.
